method: Historical mechanical steelhead replay using Muskegon River near Croton, MI — below Croton Dam USGS 04121970 daily mean discharge and measured water temperature plus each four-hour block's Open-Meteo radiation, cloud cover, and precipitation. The read is scoped to the Croton tailwater and validates scoring behavior and copy, not catch rates.
